reviews.title: Annoying “what pain today” pop-ups
reviews.text:
I used to like this app, but now every time I open it, I’m forced to answer questions about pain and other symptoms. Even after selecting “None of these,” the same pop-up keeps appearing!

I just want to track my period, not constantly think about possible health issues. These repetitive questions are intrusive and create unnecessary anxiety.

Please make these pop-ups optional. It’s annoying.

reviews.title: Not ok
reviews.text: You know you have this app that is trying to build a personal connection between you and your person and asked questions. Why can’t we go back and review the questions? It’s not fair if we have different time schedules with work and I go to read his questions and he goes, read my questions and we can’t even see if we’re compatible because you freaking erased it. I’m so over it so stupid there has to be a better app than this one.

reviews.title: Poor choice of adjectives
reviews.text: The app is useful and functional like any other tracking app available these days. The reason I first started using it was the feature to add notes and all the categories to record mood or symptoms and things like that. However recently I have noticed the kind of adjectives they use and some of the articles they share are triggering and very insensitive to anxious women or the ones who are actually having a hard time. Most of them are written in poor taste (for eg. The use of the word ‘disaster’ as one of the options to note flow. How offensive is that and even if some may find it amusing, it is very triggering. I mean this app falls under health are, it’s nit a game or a comedy app. Have some sensitivity and respect please!

reviews.title: Virus message
reviews.text: Logged on this morning & the message button was flashing red. Clicked on it and it opened a Google message with a count down timer saying my phone had been infected with a virus and I had to click the button below to save my files etc I deleted the app but wanted to notify developers - seemed linked to safari as same message was there when I went to safari to search if app had been hacked

reviews.title: New phase in life means it’s no longer useful
reviews.text: Other than the stupid pet thing this has been a good tracker, up until menopause. There is no way I can put ‘missed period’ without pretending I’m pregnant. It has technically not added a period but it has started counting from day 1 again. For this reason I will be deleting it. 2 stars because women in this stage of life often feel forgotten and this app is adding to that.

reviews.title: Bad App Dont buy it
reviews.text: They transferred my money straight to my bank account without my consent, and I didn't even intend to make that payment. As I have been experiencing my period continuously for more than I expected, I filed a complaint with the App Store, but they informed me that I cannot receive a refund of £35. I feel very confused and frightened since my period is regular. And I still get my period regularly and I’m at my menopause stage, please help me with my matter I don’t want to get sick period every after a week,  No; I want to get back to how I used to be. Period after 4 months that's what I want
